record.paper_title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
record.original_question: What are the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids? In this setting, a matroid M with a basis V is a framed Dowling matroid when every fundamental circuit with respect to V has size at most 3, and M \ V is called a Dowling matroid.

evidence.quote: If each of the fundamental circuits of M, with respect to the basis V, have size at most 3, then we call M a framed Dowling matroid with joint set V and we call the matroid M \ V a Dowling matroid.
Find the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V$ be a basis of a matroid $M$. For each element $e \notin V$, the fundamental circuit of $e$ with respect to $V$ is the unique circuit contained in $V \cup \{e\}$. Call $M$ a framed Dowling matroid with joint set $V$ if every fundamental circuit of $M$ with respect to $V$ has size at most $3$. A matroid $N$ is called a Dowling matroid if there exists a framed Dowling matroid $M$ with joint set $V$ such that $N = M \setminus V$ (delete the joint set from $M$).

The class of Dowling matroids is closed under taking minors. Determine the complete list of excluded minors for this class; that is, describe all minor-minimal matroids that are not Dowling matroids.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids is listed as an open problem in the matroid structure theory literature. Related survey and structure-theory works refer to it as unresolved; no complete characterization of the excluded minors appears in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Towards a structure theory for matrices and matroids
status_evidence.snippet: Dowling matroids are listed among basic classes in matroid structure theory; characterizing excluded minors and recognition complexity remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Excluded minors for Dowling matroids are not known.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems on excluding a uniform matroid
status_evidence.snippet: Find the excluded minors for the class of Dowling matroids.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open.
